findings.reason: the census should derive the dev-group and video-extra membership from the declaration it already reads (declaration_map) instead of mirroring them, so the guard cannot disagree with its own source of truth.
findings.text: `TOOLING` (line 92) and `LAZY_VIDEO_MODULES` (line 83) hardcode the membership of `[dependency-groups] dev` and the `video` extra as distribution lists living beside `pyproject.toml`; the census parses the declaration in `declaration_map` (line 137) yet mirrors two of its families as constants, and the default/optional check at lines 365-371 even hardcodes the group name "dev" in its failure string — so a distribution added to the dev group, or a member added to the video extra, leaves the guard asserting a membership that has moved, which is the same code-declaration drift the plan was written to retire.

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — `build_census()` (tests/test_declared_dependencies.py:290) hides the AST import walk, the module→distribution mapping, the transitive closure and the default/optional classification behind one function, and the fragment renderer consumes that same Census so the assertion and its evidence cannot disagree.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — the census re-encodes the declaration it guards into Python constants (`TOOLING` at tests/test_declared_dependencies.py:92 and `LAZY_VIDEO_MODULES` at :83) whose owner is `pyproject.toml`.
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; no section adds to any of these families, and §3 states in its own text the surface it retires (the `dev` extra is replaced by `[dependency-groups] dev`).
rubric_items.reuse_search: pass — the plan cites the uv machinery it engaged (`uv sync --all-extras`, `uv pip check`, `uv lock --check`) and its census reuses the in-repo shared resolver `tests/distribution_sources.py::editable_checkout` and stdlib `packages_distributions` rather than adding a parallel module→distribution resolver; no existing declaration checker exists in `scripts/` or `tests/` for it to have forked.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — no section adds a wrapper: §5 extends the existing pytest-timeout mechanism (`[tool.pytest.ini_options] timeout = 300` plus `@pytest.mark.timeout(N)`) and bounds the clive wait through that owner's knob (`imas_ambix/agent/clive.py:190` `retry_seconds` / `CLIVE_CATALOG_RETRY_BOUND`), and §3 replaced the `dev` extra with a `[dependency-groups] dev` group instead of layering a new entry point over it.
